title: Passive Voice: Requests and Orders — Quiz 105
content:
## Passive Voice: Requests and Orders

Use let with an object and passive infinitive to report instructions.

### Lesson focus

1. Keep Eid simple.
2. Let Eid be kept simple.
3. Invite them to tea.
4. Set up more Oxygen plants.
5. Recognise us as frontline warriors.
6. Don't share your passwords, PIN, OTP, CVV and other personal details with anyone online or through phone.

### Practise with the image

Read the full lesson image for the original exercise, notes and any answer key shown. Write your own answers before checking a key. A key labelled for another quiz belongs to that quiz.
